rule.description: go/analysis rule: a member of the reform core row and view contracts (reform.View, reform.Struct) that some concrete owner in the module satisfies with a vacuous body (empty, constant-literal-only return, or panic-only) is a capability the contract forces on an owner that does not use it; the same AST predicate is applied to every owner in every repository state.

checks.description: Record construction (reform.View.NewRecord) is required from view metadata owners that never produce records.
checks.detected_relation: view descriptor owner -> NewRecord capability forced through reform.View
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Producing a new record is a table concern; the fat reform.View interface drags it into every view owner, which can only return nil.

matches.evidence: compositePkViewType implements reform.View.NewRecord (internal/test/models/good_reform.go:691) with a return of constant literals only; this owner is a descriptor owner for an SQL view or composite-key relation without a single-column primary key, so the member cannot carry real behavior here.
